This looks solid. The file compiles cleanly with strict TS, uses `role="radiogroup"`, native radios/checkboxes for accessibility, and logical CSS properties so it flips correctly under the app's RTL Arabic locale.

Summary of what was built in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` / `Screen.module.css`:
- Delivery address card with a "Change" link that cycles between two mock saved addresses.
- Delivery slot picker as three radio choices (Today morning/afternoon, Tomorrow evening).
- Item list (6 mock grocery items) each with a working quantity stepper and line total.
- Promo code field with mock codes (`SAVE10`, `WELCOME5`, `FREESHIP`) and validation/removal.
- Price breakdown (subtotal, delivery — free over $30 or with `FREESHIP`, discount, total) plus a "Place order" button that shows a confirmation message.

I couldn't inspect `@strata/react`'s actual component API since `node_modules` isn't installed and the package tarballs live outside this folder, so I built the UI with semantic HTML/CSS Modules styled via Strata's CSS custom properties (with safe fallbacks), matching the pattern already used in `app.css`.
